input.rawConfigs.label: Raw Configs
input.rawConfigs.placeholder: Paste VLESS://, VMESS://, TROJAN://, SS:// links, one per line
input.cdnList.label: CDN IP / Domain List
input.cdnList.placeholder: Enter CDN IPs or domains, one per line
rows.title: Routing Subdomains
rows.note: Auto-filled from each config's host parameter, or from its connect address when that is a hostname. Otherwise (IP address) the field is required. The value must be a hostname of at least two labels — IP addresses, trailing dots and non-ASCII names are rejected. Your edits persist: a field you clear stays cleared and blocks generation until you type a value or reset the row.
rows.requiredError: Routing subdomain required — fill this field to enable generation.
rows.invalidError: Invalid routing subdomain — it must be a hostname of at least two labels, using only ASCII letters, digits and hyphens. IP addresses are not accepted.
rows.trailingDotError: Remove the trailing dot — it belongs to SNI, not to the routing subdomain. Turn on Random SNI to get it in generated links.
rows.deleteTitle: Delete this line from Raw Configs
rows.transportError: This transport cannot pass a CDN. Only ws, xhttp, grpc and httpupgrade can — change the transport on your server, or delete this row.
rows.securityError: REALITY cannot pass a CDN, and no transport security other than plain or TLS is accepted. Change it on your server, or delete this row.
rows.flowError: This config works with no client at all: xtls-rprx-vision needs a direct TLS or REALITY connection, or VLESS Encryption. No CDN setting can fix it.
rows.ssPluginError: Shadowsocks plugin links are not supported: the plugin form cannot carry ALPN, fingerprint, or an SNI distinct from the routing subdomain. Use the Xray-native ss link your panel can produce.
rows.unparsedError: Not a recognised proxy link. Only vless, vmess, trojan and ss links are read.
config.randomSniHint: 8-12 random chars + root domain + trailing dot (FQDN bypass)
config.portRequired: Select at least one port for active mode
config.alpnRequired: Select at least one ALPN option
config.fingerprintRequired: Select at least one fingerprint option
config.includeExcluded: Include excluded configs in the output
config.includeExcludedHint: Off: generated links only. On: each excluded row's original text is copied into the output unchanged — for a mixed subscription you want back as one list.
